done_when: forge doctor and forge upgrade print one suggested fast_test line for the repo's test kind: Python repos get forge test --pytest {base}; vitest or jest repos get their runner on changed files with --passWithNoTests using the repo's own install and runner; mixed repos get one part per kind; Go, Rust, Java, .NET and Ruby repos get no line; skill.md says so; new and existing client repos each have a command test

findings.body: The previous finding remains open. For `uv run pytest && npm ci && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint . && npm test`, where npm test invokes Vitest or Jest, direct ESLint gets an empty kind. The Python picker retains it while removing Node installation and runners (src/forge/fasttest.py:120–121), then executes it at line 171. With selected Python tests or changed shared inputs, this fails before installation when dependencies are absent; otherwise ESLint runs twice. Direct `./node_modules/.bin/tsc` checks have the same problem. This direct-executable evidence is outside the coordinator's isolation ruling. Classify these checks consistently so suggestions from both doctor and upgrade run them once, after installation.
findings.title: Keep installation before direct Node checks in mixed suggestions

findings.body: The previous finding remains open. `npm exec jest --workspace=web` becomes `npm exec -- jest --workspace=web --changedSince {base} --passWithNoTests`. Inserting the separator before the runner changes npm's workspace option into a runner argument, losing the original execution context. Vitest and trailing npm options such as `--package` are affected through both doctor and upgrade. [npm's documented contract](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-exec/#npx-vs-npm-exec) confirms that npm parses configuration options after positional arguments until `--`. This trailing-option case goes beyond the earlier leading-option repair. Preserve npm configuration options before the inserted separator.
findings.title: Preserve trailing npm options when inserting the exec separator

why: Repos without a quick test setting don't learn which quick test command fits them
